summary: Task 2 frontend foundation is implemented correctly and stays within its foundation-only mandate. All 12 ui/ directories exist with barrel index.ts (dialog/ untouched per Decision 14), both locales carry the full subscribers/tags/customFields/exports namespaces and the parity gate (check-locales.mjs) exits 0, the sidebar sub-nav is inlined in default.vue (no new component) mirroring SettingsSubnav with NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES-sourced prefix stripping, and the 4 page shells are minimal i18n-only headings. AC6 active-state logic is sound: bases diverge at their final segment so /tags highlights only Tags while /subscribers/{id} keeps the Subscribers parent+child active via prefix-match. No stores, API calls, middleware, or business logic were added; package.json delta is the expected CLI-added vue-sonner only.
